root_cause.text: In `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range`, the code incorrectly used `head->rc_curpage` (a page index) as a byte offset into the destination page for `memcpy`, instead of the correct byte offset `head->rc_pageoff`, causing writes beyond the intended location and potential memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the change from `memcpy(dst + head->rc_curpage, ...)` to `memcpy((unsigned char *)dst + head->rc_pageoff, ...)`, and the commit message states that `rc_curpage` was added to the page base instead of `rc_pageoff`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix destination pointer computation in svc_rdma_copy_inline_range by using byte offset rc_pageoff instead of page index rc_curpage.
intent_record.what: Changed the destination pointer in memcpy from 'dst + head->rc_curpage' to '(unsigned char *)dst + head->rc_pageoff', replacing the page index with a byte offset and adding an explicit unsigned char pointer cast.
intent_record.how: This corrects the memory copy destination to be the proper byte offset within the current page (head->rc_pageoff) instead of an incorrect page index (head->rc_curpage), ensuring that inline RDMA data is copied to the intended location. The cast guarantees correct byte-level pointer arithmetic.
